title: Forest Data Partnership Portolan Catalog
description:
Cloud-native Mirror (Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs, organized with Portolan) of the [Forest Data Partnership](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/publisher/forestdatapartnership) commodity maps produced by Google.

Per-pixel probability (0 to 1) that land is planted with cocoa, coffee, oil palm or rubber, at 10 m resolution, from the community model release 2026a. The first release of this mirror covers 2024 for the West African cocoa belt (224 one-degree tiles from Sierra Leone to Gabon, all four commodities). More years and regions will follow. Each commodity-year also carries a pan-tropical overview (about 320 m) for fast low-zoom viewing.

Google publishes the source in a requester-pays Cloud Storage bucket, so every read is billed to the reader and browsers cannot load it. This mirror serves the same files unchanged over plain HTTPS with range requests and CORS: no account, no billing, readable from QGIS, GDAL, Python and web maps.
